# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

RepoExe strives to keep packages updated. Security patches are typically only
applied to the latest `main` branch components. Since the repository operates on
a rolling release model via CI/CD, older releases are generally not supported
for security backports.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within the RepoExe packages or build
scripts, please do not disclose it publicly until it has been addressed.

You can report vulnerabilities by:

1. Opening a **private security issue** on the GitHub repository (if enabled).
2. Emailing **sjnexecontact@gmail.com** directly.

We will endeavor to respond to your report within 48 hours and work with you to
resolve the issue promptly.
